note: LB.7d identity fixture (legacy-only, no matrix cell). A C# 10 file-scoped `namespace X;` is the block form's syntax sugar, so its types take the namespace scope the block form already gets (Shop::Core::Order). A namespace-less type drops the file stem (LB.2 rule: Svc::Widget). A C# 11 `file` type is file-local by the language and keeps the file segment, so two `file class Scratch` stay two nodes. HEAD: Svc::Widget::Widget::Run, Svc::Order::Order::Total.
